summary.description: One line, used when the tile is too small.

status.description: Colors the bar ok, warn or error.

tone.description: Fill color when `status` is not set. Default: `accent`.

anyOf.description:
`Stat`, `Gauge` and `Pie` are rendered inline (the TUI shows a pie as
its largest slice); others fall back to text.

oneOf.description: The theme's accent color.
Green to yellow to red by value, relative to the maximum.
Teal to blue to violet by value.
Violet to pink to orange by value.

key.description: Names the cell in each row's `cells`.

priority.description:
Which columns to keep when a table is too narrow for all of them:
renderers drop the lowest priority first (the rightmost of equal
ones) and always keep the first column. Default 0.

action.description: What clicking the item does, e.g. open a link.

status.description: Colors the item's marker ok, warn or error.

tone.description: Color of the item's marker when `status` is not set.

level.description: error, warn, info or debug: colors the line.

tone.description: A fixed color for this meter instead of the grid's color scale.

action.description: What clicking the row does, e.g. open a link.

status.description: Colors the row's marker ok, warn or error.

name.description: Shown in the legend; also keys the history when the widget has an `id`.

tone.description:
This series' color, instead of the widget's `color` (one series) or
the next `series-N` token (several).

oneOf.description: Filled under the line.
One column per sample.

status.description: Colors the slice ok, warn or error.

tone.description: Color when `status` is not set. Default: the next `series-N` token.

value.description: Zero or more. Shown with the widget's `format` and `unit`.

error.description: The percent at which the fill turns the error color.

warn.description: The percent at which the fill turns the warn color.

Tone.description: A token a widget can color something with, e.g. one line of a chart.

history.description: Recent results, oldest first. Renderers show the newest that fit.

latency_ms.description: Response time of the latest check.

uptime.description: Share of recent checks that passed, 0-100.

url.description: Opened when the check is clicked.

oneOf.description: Show as KiB / MiB / GiB; `unit` is appended (e.g. "/s").
Show large counts short: 950, 12.3k, 4.2M, 1.1B.
A paragraph of text.

markdown.description: Read markdown in `text`: `**bold**`, and code between backticks.

oneOf.description: One number with a label, e.g. "p99 107 ms".

delta.description: A change to show beside the value, e.g. "+2.8%".

label.description: Shown above or before the value.

status.description: Colors the value: ok, warn or error.

unit.description: Shown after the value, smaller, e.g. "ms" or "/s".

oneOf.description: A horizontal meter from 0 to 100%.

caption.description: A line under the meter, e.g. "1721 of 1858 GiB used".

marker.description: A tick on the track at this percent, e.g. where usage should be by now.

thresholds.description: Percents at which the fill turns warn and error colored.

oneOf.description: Values over time, as a line, a filled area or bars.

color.description: The color of a single series.

format.description: How values are written: plain, bytes or count.

history.description: Points the host keeps per series when `id` is set. Default 300.

id.description:
When set, the host keeps history for this widget: each update's
`points` are new samples, appended to what the host already holds
for (tile, `id`, series name). Renderers always get the full history.

mirrored.description:
Draw the first series above the axis and the second below it,
e.g. network download and upload.

series.description: One or more lines, each with its points.

style.description: A line, a filled area or one bar per sample.

y_max.description: The top of the chart. Default: the largest value.

oneOf.description: Many small meters in a compact grid, e.g. one per CPU core.

color.description: The meters' color: `accent`, or a scale colored by each meter's value.

oneOf.description: Labeled horizontal bars, in the order given.

format.description: How values are written: plain, bytes or count.

max.description: Value of a full bar. Default: the largest value.

oneOf.description:
Shares of a whole, as a pie or donut with a legend. Slices keep the
order given; each one's share is its value over the sum of all values.

color.description:
`accent` (the default) gives each slice its own color, the theme's
accent first. The other scales spread the slices along the scale
in order. A slice's `status` overrides its color.

donut.description: A ring with a hole in the middle. Default true; false draws a full disc.

format.description: How values are written in the legend: plain, bytes or count.

unit.description: Shown after each value in the legend.

oneOf.description: Items with a title, a subtitle, a status marker and tags.

empty_text.description: Shown when there are no items.

oneOf.description: Rows and columns. A cell holds text, a number, or a stat, gauge or pie.
Log output, oldest first. Renderers show the newest lines that fit.
Availability checks, one row each with a strip of recent results.
Widgets side by side, sharing the width.
Widgets stacked top to bottom.
